text:
Alice: quick architecture question — we're getting recurring headroom thrash when late-join tenants hit continuous batches. thinking about a lease-convergence phase that temporarily gates admission for 5-10ms to let coalescing stabilize. anyone seen this pattern?

Ben: saw similar in the last run. main tradeoff is increased p99 for tiny requests vs fewer eviction spikes for big tenants. gating looks promising if it's tiny. :thinking_face:

Carla: telemetry note — we need to tag those gated admissions or we'll lose signal. otherwise rollout will look like a perf regression for some customers.

Ethan: agree with Carla. also +1 to making the gate adaptive. e.g. "convergence_ms = min( max(quantile_latency*0.2, 2), 12)" and expose as knob. sample config: 
```
batcher: 
  convergence_ms: 8  # default, adaptive at runtime
  max_queued_tokens: 4096
  soft_isolation: true
```

Fiona: fallback behavior? if the gate causes missed SLO we need immediate fallback to fastpath or a cheaper model. otherwise ops pages us.

Ben: fallback should be a policy: after N attempts with gated stall, mark tenant as "fastpath-eligible" for T seconds. that prevents repeated stalls.

Alice: good call. how do folks feel about lease rebalancing frequency — aggressive rebalance vs staying sticky to avoid churn?

Carla: sticky wins for stable throughput. rebalance only when imbalance > threshold (e.g., 30% headroom delta) or after eviction storms. plus add hysteresis timer.

Ethan: implementation sketch — keep per-tenant lease score, decay slowly, trigger rebalance when score crosses threshold. pseudo: 
```
score[t] = score[t] * 0.95 + headroom_penalty(t)
if score[t] > 0.7: consider_rebalance(t)
```
Keep rebalance ops rate-limited.

Fiona: and make sure we surface a rollout dashboard: lease events, gated admissions, fastpath toggles. ops need per-tenant timeline to debug.

SchedBot: deployment notice — batcher-convergence v2 rolled to canary (node pool: batch-canary-3) at 2026-02-14T15:22Z :rocket:

Alice: thanks, everyone. action items: (1) Ethan will prototype adaptive convergence_ms + score-based rebalance, (2) Carla adds telemetry tags for gated admissions, (3) Ben drafts fallback policy, (4) Fiona designs dashboard wireframe. We'll sync next week — ping me if you need quicker checkins. :thumbsup:
